name: What is the typical cost range for an outdoor kitchen in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for an outdoor kitchen in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an outdoor kitchen in Las Vegas varies widely based on size, materials, appliances, and features. A basic setup might start from $5,000 to $10,000 for a grill island with minimal amenities. More elaborate kitchens, featuring multiple appliances like refrigerators, sinks, pizza ovens, and extensive counter space, can range from $15,000 to $50,000 or more. High-end custom designs using premium finishes and advanced technology can exceed $75,000. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site consultation to match your budget and vision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Outdoor kitchen costs in Las Vegas vary from $5,000 for basic setups to over $75,000 for high-end custom designs, depending on features and materials.
